name: Lola's Math Train
description:
Join Lola on her journey as she
makes her way through a fun filled
environment of bright colors and
creative problem solving to get all of
her friends to a party! Specifically
designed for children 3-7 years old,
Lola’s Math Train encourages children
to learn key skills like adding and
puzzle solving all while having fun!
disclaimer: This software does not support 3D display.
